entry.title: The Large N Limit of Superconformal Field Theories and Supergravity
entry.summary: We show that the large $N$ limit of certain conformal field theories in various dimensions include in their Hilbert space a sector describing supergravity on the product of Anti-deSitter spacetimes, spheres and other compact manifolds. This is shown by taking some branes in the full M/string theory and then taking a low energy limit where the field theory on the brane decouples from the bulk.

entry.title: A $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{n})$ bound with \textit{no} version suffix
entry.summary: We prove that the error is at most $10^{-3}$ when $\alpha \leq \frac{1}{2}$, improving the previous $O(n)$ bound; the constant is explicit and the proof is short & elementary.
